items.name: genui-theme
items.title: GenUI Theme
items.description: The GenUI palette: neutral grays after Halaska UI, white bordered cards on a #fafafa page in light, and pure black hollow bordered cards in dark; a violet `choice` accent for selection and active interaction; translucent fills. Optional; components also work with any shadcn theme. Text uses Geist (load it with next/font and expose it as --font-sans); big figures use Instrument Serif (expose it as --font-instrument-serif); the CD Player's handwritten disc lettering uses Gochi Hand (expose it as --font-gochi-hand).

items.name: renderer
items.title: Renderer
items.description: Renders generated-UI calls from any agent framework, composed into one response, with shared lifecycle states, nested layouts and binds between components. Includes AI SDK, LangGraph and AG-UI adapters, a catalog-to-prompt builder, input validation worded for the model, a Markdown fallback an OpenUI library export a json-render catalog adapter and an A2UI catalog and message adapter.

items.name: change-preview
items.title: Change Preview
items.description: Editable before/after preview of changes an agent wants to make. The user can skip or edit each change, then approve or reject. Category: Act.

items.name: question-stepper
items.title: Question Stepper
items.description: Paginated card that batches the questions an agent needs answered before it proceeds. Options with recommendations, multi-select, free text, skip and "let agent decide". Category: Collect.

items.name: follow-up-chips
items.title: Follow-up Chips
items.description: One-tap next steps the agent offers after an answer, as chips or a related-questions list. Category: Compose.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sortable records the agent pulled from real data, with flagged rows, selection and bulk actions. Category: Visualize.

items.name: calculator
items.title: Calculator
items.description: A single-use calculator the agent builds from inputs and safe formulas, never code. Category: Tools.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: An answer whose claims link to retrieved sources: inline chips with previews and a sources list. Category: Transparency.

items.name: summary-card
items.title: Summary Card
items.description: The at-a-glance header for a plan or overview: title, one-line summary and key facts. Category: Compose.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: The one notice in a reply the user must not miss, with a restrained tone system. Category: Compose.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: Steps the user carries out over time, with times or owners, progress and optional submit. Category: Tools.

items.name: layout-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Splits a reply into 2–5 parallel views, each holding other GenUI components rendered through the Renderer. Category: Layout.

items.name: layout-columns
items.title: Columns
items.description: Puts 2–3 GenUI components side by side for comparison; stacks on phones. Category: Layout.

items.name: layout-stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Stacks 2–6 GenUI components one under the other as one tool call; a child can bind to a sibling's result. Category: Layout.

items.name: layout-grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Arranges 2–9 mixed GenUI components in a 2–3 column grid, with items that can span wider; one column on phones. Category: Layout.

items.name: layout-split
items.title: Split
items.description: A main GenUI component with a narrower aside beside it; they stack on phones. Category: Layout.

items.name: layout-steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A numbered 2–6 step procedure where each step is its own GenUI component, and later steps can bind to earlier ones. Category: Layout.

items.name: entity-card
items.title: Entity Card
items.description: Products, places or people the agent found, as cards with image, price, rating and short facts, in a carousel or a list, with per-card actions. Category: Compose.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A line, bar or area chart of figures from a tool result, with event markers and an accessible data table. Category: Visualize.

items.name: scatter-plot
items.title: Scatter Plot
items.description: Two measures plotted against each other from a tool result: grouped points with distinct shapes, bubbles sized by a third measure, a trend line with its strength, labelled highlights and an accessible data table. Category: Visualize.

items.name: distribution-chart
items.title: Distribution Chart
items.description: How the values of one measure are spread, from individual values in a tool result: a histogram with round bins, box plots per group with Tukey whiskers and outliers, or a stacked dot plot, with median and middle-half facts, reference markers and accessible summary tables. Category: Visualize.

items.name: usage-chart
items.title: Usage Chart
items.description: One metered quantity per day from a tool result (tokens, energy, data, spend) as a stepped area, with an optional cached or partial share drawn over it. Dragging, touching or arrowing across it moves a cursor, dims the days after it, shows the day's figures and recalculates 1-3 summary figures (total, average, peak, cost) and the date range for the period up to that day, with an accessible per-day table. Category: Visualize.

items.name: composition-chart
items.title: Composition Chart
items.description: What a whole is made of, from amounts in a tool result: a donut with the total or a highlighted share in the centre, 100% bars to compare the mix across groups, a waffle of 100 squares, or a squarified treemap, with a legend of amounts and shares, Other folding and an optional remainder of a stated total. Category: Visualize.

items.name: sankey-diagram
items.title: Sankey Diagram
items.description: Where an amount flows across stages, from one row per flow in a tool result: bands as wide as the amount, stages from the longest path, nodes ordered to cut crossings, loops dropped and counted, a traced highlight, hover details and an accessible table of flows. Category: Visualize.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Ordered events with a state each: shipment tracking, incident timelines, project milestones. Category: Visualize.

items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: Places on an interactive MapLibre map with an accessible list: show a numbered route, pick a place, drop a pin, lay out a multi-day itinerary, or show places to stay near a named place with picks and distances. Category: Visualize.

items.name: guided-flow
items.title: Guided Flow
items.description: A short multi-step flow in the chat: choices, time slots, validated fields and a review step with edit links. Category: Collect.

items.name: generated-form
items.title: Generated Form
items.description: An agent-generated form for structured input with client-side validation, inline errors and a read-only restore. Category: Collect.

items.name: entity-picker
items.title: Entity Picker
items.description: Choose one or more real records the agent fetched, with search, groups, min/max and a keyboard-operable listbox. Category: Collect.

items.name: slot-picker
items.title: Slot Picker
items.description: Date and time slot selection from real availability in a stated timezone, with taken slots shown disabled. Category: Collect.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Ask for files with stated rules (type, size, aspect ratio); drag-and-drop slots with previews. The agent gets metadata, the host gets the files. Category: Collect.

items.name: draft-options
items.title: Draft Options
items.description: Two to four alternative drafts: pick one, edit it inline and apply, or ask for new ones, with a word diff against the original. Category: Refine.

items.name: result-receipt
items.title: Result Receipt
items.description: What the agent just did: what changed, when, a link, and undo with a live countdown while it's still possible. Category: Act.

items.name: activity-trail
items.title: Activity Trail
items.description: The searches, reads and tool calls behind an answer, with outcomes, durations and a computed summary. Category: Transparency.

items.name: streaming-skeleton
items.title: Streaming Skeleton
items.description: A host-side placeholder shown while a tool call's name or props are still unknown: card, table, list, text and media shapes. Category: Status.

items.name: product-options
items.title: Product Options
items.description: Choose a product's size, color or other options and a quantity, with live price and stock-aware variants, then add it to the cart. Category: Collect.

items.name: cart
items.title: Cart
items.description: Review the cart before checkout: quantities, removal, shipping and live totals, then hand off to the host's own checkout. Never collects payment. Category: Act.

items.name: file-browser
items.title: File Browser
items.description: Navigate a folder tree from the user's storage and pick files: breadcrumb, list and grid views, sorting, selection that persists across folders, and a keyboard-operable ARIA grid. Category: Collect.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Pick one or more colors from a host palette, with grouped swatches, WCAG contrast, nearest matches (OKLab ΔE), swatch/text/UI previews and an optional custom mixer. Category: Collect.

items.name: simulation
items.title: Simulation
items.description: An interactive what-if model that runs over time: sliders, a chart with a baseline, milestones and a scrubber, computed locally with safe formulas. Category: Tools.

items.name: insight-card
items.title: Insight Card
items.description: One personal insight from the user's own data, with a tiny visual: bubbles, dot calendar, progress, compare or streak. Category: Visualize.

items.name: stock-quote
items.title: Stock Quote
items.description: A market snapshot for one stock, ETF, index or crypto: price, change, candlestick or line chart per range with high/low callouts, key stats and source. Category: Visualize.

items.name: weather
items.title: Weather
items.description: A forecast for one place: current conditions, alerts, hourly strip, daily range bars and the agent's one-line answer, with a °C/°F toggle. Category: Visualize.

items.name: weather-outlook
items.title: Weather Outlook
items.description: A plain 5 to 7 day forecast for one place: each day's icon, high and low, with today marked. No hours, wind or alerts. Category: Visualize.

items.name: timer
items.title: Timer
items.description: A working countdown, interval timer or stopwatch that survives reloads, with laps, ±1 min and an announcement at zero. Category: Tools.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: Playback for a recording with a seekable waveform, markers, a clip range and a synced transcript. Category: Visualize.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: The user's real schedule as a week or day time grid, a month of day tiles, or a what's-on-today list of events and to-dos, with events coloured by calendar. Press an event for its details, switch views and page through time. Proposed creates, moves and cancels show in place with conflicts flagged, and the user includes or leaves out each change before anything is written. Category: Act.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Work items from the user's tracker by stage. The user reorganizes them by drag, keyboard or move menu, reviews agent-suggested moves, and every change goes back to the agent. Category: Act.

items.name: email-thread
items.title: Email Thread
items.description: An email conversation from the user's mailbox, read in context with a highlighted answer, plus an optional drafted reply the user edits and approves before anything is sent. Category: Act.

items.name: invoice
items.title: Invoice
items.description: One invoice, bill or receipt the agent found: state, due or paid date, parties, line items, taxes and reconciled totals, with pay (a handoff to the host's payment flow), download, dispute and add-to-expenses actions. Category: Act.

items.name: article
items.title: Article
items.description: A long-form document in the chat: sections, a contents list that tracks scrolling, citations, and Markdown copy and download. Category: Compose.

items.name: hotel-booking
items.title: Hotel Booking
items.description: One hotel's rooms and rates for the user's stay: dates and guests, rooms that fit the party, the full price with taxes, fees due at the hotel and cancellation terms, handed off to the host's booking flow. Also shows an existing reservation with copy, directions, manage and a two-step cancel. Category: Collect.

items.name: flight-ticket
items.title: Flight Ticket
items.description: A flight booking or boarding pass the agent found: route with local times per airport, journey bar with layovers (short connections flagged), terminal, gate, seat and class, passengers, a ticket-stub boarding pass with a code placeholder, and check-in, wallet, seat, manage and share handoff actions. Category: Act.

items.name: flight-status
items.title: Flight Status
items.description: Live status of one flight: state badge with computed delay, local departure and arrival times with changed schedules struck through, an animated progress bar, remaining time, gates, baggage belt, altitude and speed, updates, and an optional notify-me action. Category: Visualize.

items.name: showtimes
items.title: Showtimes
items.description: Pick one session from a venue's schedule: a day strip, titles with time chips, sold-out and few-left states, a ticket stepper and a price total. Category: Collect.

items.name: world-clock
items.title: World Clock
items.description: Analog or digital clocks for 1–6 places, live or at a given moment, with offsets, day relations and a working-hours overlap planner. Category: Tools.

items.name: seat-map
items.title: Seat Map
items.description: Pick seats on a real layout (plane, cinema, theater, train, bus or venue): one seat per passenger or a set count, sections, paid and taken seats, a keyboard-operable ARIA grid, and a summary with a together hint and price total. Category: Collect.

items.name: restaurant-reservation
items.title: Restaurant Reservation
items.description: One restaurant's real open tables for the user's party: day strip, lunch and dinner times with seating areas, party size that never invents availability, occasion, dietary needs and a note, deposit and policies, handed off to the host's booking flow. Also shows an existing reservation with copy, directions, call and a two-step cancel. Category: Collect.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: A scannable QR code for a link, guest Wi-Fi, a contact card (vCard), an event (iCalendar), an email or phone number, or text, with a readable summary, PNG/SVG download and copy. Category: Tools.

items.name: kpi-card
items.title: KPI Card
items.description: A compact metric card for business or finance numbers: a headline, one visual (segments, dots, treemap or bars), a legend with deltas and a footer total, optionally per period. Category: Visualize.

items.name: account-balances
items.title: Account Balances
items.description: The user's money across connected accounts at a glance: a net total with dimmed cents and its change, an allocation bar of assets, each account with masked identifier, liabilities subtracted, conversion and staleness flags, and a hide-amounts toggle. Read-only: add-account, view-details and reconnect handoffs only. Category: Visualize.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: Days left until a date that matters: calendar-correct across DST, tightening to hours and seconds as it gets close, with progress, working days, milestones, other dates, an .ics download and share. Category: Tools.

items.name: slide-gallery
items.title: Slide Gallery
items.description: A slideshow of photos, design options or deck slides in the chat: a stage with swipe and keyboard navigation, thumbnails, a full-screen lightbox, speaker notes, optional autoplay, and an optional single or multiple pick sent back to the agent. Category: Visualize.

items.name: option-builder
items.title: Option Builder
items.description: Pick a combination of options where each choice carries metrics (cost, size, load time), with live totals, budgets, a score, dependencies and conflicts. Category: Collect.

items.name: car-rental
items.title: Car Rental
items.description: Real rental car offers for a trip: filters and sorting, specs, mileage, fuel policy, pick-up type and rating, cover with excess, extras, an automatic young driver fee, the deposit and a full price breakdown (pay now vs at desk), handed off to the host's booking flow, plus a change-trip refetch. Also shows an existing rental with copy, directions, manage, add to calendar and a two-step cancel. Category: Collect.

items.name: region-map
items.title: Region Map
items.description: A static data map of US states or countries shaded by a value, with labelled callout pins and an accessible data table. Category: Visualize.

items.name: social-post
items.title: Social Post
items.description: Posts the agent found, in a neutral feed, or a post it drafted for one or more networks that the user edits, schedules and approves before anything is published. Character counters, thread splitting, alt-text checks and best-time suggestions. Category: Act.

items.name: music-player
items.title: Music Player
items.description: Music from the user's music app: what's playing now with remote controls, or a playlist to preview, reorder by drag or keyboard, trim and save. Category: Act.

items.name: cd-player
items.title: CD Player
items.description: A few albums from the user's music app as CDs under a player. The user drops one in by click, drag or keyboard; it flies into the player, spins and plays its preview, and the previous disc goes back to its slot. Each pick returns the album id. Category: Act.

items.name: approval-request
items.title: Approval Request
items.description: The agent pauses before one specific action and asks permission, with scope, cost, reversibility and consequences visible. The user can adjust parameters, approve, reject with a reason, ask for changes or pick a safer alternative. Category: Act.

items.name: design-review
items.title: Design Review
items.description: Human in the loop for design systems: a designer reviews a change the AI proposed (rule, component, token, pattern or artifact), compares current and proposed, sees impact, checks and evidence, then approves, declines or sends it back with changes. Category: Act.

items.name: permission-scope
items.title: Permission Scope
items.description: The access a task needs, scope by scope with its risk, granted for a chosen duration.

items.name: autonomy-control
items.title: Autonomy Control
items.description: How much the agent may do without asking, picked level by level.

items.name: handoff
items.title: Handoff
items.description: Hand a task to a person or agent, with context and an editable note.

items.name: confidence
items.title: Confidence
items.description: How sure the agent is, with evidence for and against.

items.name: checkpoint
items.title: Checkpoint
items.description: Restore points of a long run; roll back or continue.

items.name: task-queue
items.title: Task Queue
items.description: Queued tasks in run order, with reorder, pause, cancel and approve.

items.name: recovery-panel
items.title: Recovery Panel
items.description: When the agent can't finish what it proposed: what happened, what still worked, and concrete ways to continue (retry, reconnect, request access, fix input, pick an alternative, skip, contact, cancel). Category: Status.

items.name: plan-review
items.title: Plan Review
items.description: The agent's step-by-step plan before it runs anything. The user reorders (drag or keyboard), edits, removes with undo, adds or skips steps, is warned about broken dependencies, then approves or requests changes. Category: Refine.

items.name: assumptions
items.title: Assumptions
items.description: What an answer is based on: the agent's assumptions, what it doesn't know and what limits the answer. The user can correct any of it so the agent redoes the work. Category: Transparency.

items.name: answer-feedback
items.title: Answer Feedback
items.description: A thumbs up or down under an answer, with a short closed list of reasons for a thumbs down and an optional Regenerate. Category: Transparency.

items.name: ranked-recommendations
items.title: Ranked Recommendations
items.description: A shortlist ranked for the user's situation: why each option fits, honest trade-offs, and which must-have and nice-to-have constraints it meets. Optional single or multiple selection. Category: Explore.

items.name: execution-progress
items.title: Execution Progress
items.description: Live progress of a job the agent is running: steps, outputs, elapsed time and ETA, with pause/resume, a confirmed cancel, skip or retry for failed steps, and Review for steps waiting on the user. Category: Status.

items.name: comparison-matrix
items.title: Comparison Matrix
items.description: Compare 2–5 options side by side across shared criteria, with differences, best values per row and an optional weighted score marked, and optionally pick one. Category: Explore.

items.name: preference-controls
items.title: Preference Controls
items.description: The constraints behind an answer (budget, priorities, tone, length, dates, must-haves) as controls the user tunes to have the agent redo it, with presets, a change summary and an optional live mode. Category: Refine.

items.name: search-results
items.title: Search Results
items.description: A collection the agent retrieved: search again, filter with facets computed from the data, sort, switch list/grid, load more pages and optionally pick results. Category: Explore.

items.name: artifact-preview
items.title: Artifact Preview
items.description: A file the agent generated or found, previewed in the chat: the browser's PDF viewer, images with zoom, numbered code and text, a CSV table, a collapsible JSON tree or rendered Markdown, with an expanded view and download, open, copy and regenerate actions. Category: Compose.

items.name: inline-editor
items.title: Inline Editor
items.description: Edit generated output in place: text section by section with word diffs, undo and targeted rewrites of a section or selected passage, or structured fields with validation. Category: Refine.

items.name: editable-table
items.title: Editable Table
items.description: Records the user corrects in place like a small spreadsheet: typed cells (text, number, select, link, date), keyboard grid, add and delete rows, undo and redo, then save. Returns only what changed. Category: Refine.

items.name: relationship-explorer
items.title: Relationship Explorer
items.description: An interactive graph of how things connect: org charts (tree), dependencies and cause and effect (flow), networks. Pan, zoom, select a node to see its links; keyboard-accessible tree or listbox mirror. Category: Explore.

items.name: price-details
items.title: Price Details
items.description: Everything about one item's price before buying: current price and saving, unit and member price, a deal verdict, price history with low/high callouts, the delivered cost breakdown with reconciliation, and other sellers' offers sorted by delivered total, with watch-price and add-to-cart actions. Category: Visualize.

items.name: delivery-tracker
items.title: Delivery Tracker
items.description: Live tracking of one delivery (food, groceries, parcel or ride): current-stage heading with arrival time or window, a minutes-left badge, a segmented stage bar, issue row, courier with rating and call button, collapsible items, and actions to contact the merchant, send delivery instructions or get help. Category: Visualize.

items.name: funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: A conversion funnel from analytics: people per step, drop-off between steps with the biggest drop marked, overall conversion vs the previous period, segments with a Compare view, an opportunity estimate, drill-down and CSV export. Category: Visualize.

items.name: medication-reminder
items.title: Medication Reminder
items.description: A medicine or supplement schedule from the user's own data: this week's doses at a glance, today's doses to mark taken or skip, course end and refill warnings. Never suggests doses. Category: Tools.

items.name: forecast
items.title: Forecast
items.description: A metric projected into the future with honest uncertainty: actuals, the median with 80% and 50% bands, scenarios, and when it reaches a goal or crosses a limit. Category: Visualize.

items.name: db-meter
items.title: dB Meter
items.description: A sound level meter: approximate live levels from the user's microphone (only after they press Start, nothing recorded) or a sensor reading, with bands, purpose verdicts, a peak-hold gauge, Leq stats and a sparkline. Category: Tools.

items.name: preferences-wizard
items.title: Preferences Wizard
items.description: A step-by-step setup of the user's lasting preferences (cards, chips, scale, ranking, toggles, schedule, text) with skip, a segmented progress bar, a review with edit links and saved progress. Category: Collect.

items.name: todo-list
items.title: To-do List
items.description: The user's own to-do list, from their tasks app or drafted by the agent, editable in the chat: quick add with date/priority parsing, tick off, inline edit, due/priority/delete with undo, drag or keyboard reorder, agent suggestions, and one change set on save. Category: Tools.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Intensity across two dimensions: a day × hour or any rows × columns matrix, a GitHub-style calendar of days, or a cohort retention triangle, with an accessible grid and data table. Category: Visualize.

items.name: lab-results
items.title: Lab Results
items.description: A lab panel with each value placed on the lab's reference range (below / within / above, optional optimal band), flags and trends from earlier tests. Never interprets. Category: Visualize.

items.name: encyclopedia-snippet
items.title: Encyclopedia Snippet
items.description: A short, credited encyclopedia-style summary of a person, thing or place: lead paragraphs, an infobox with image and facts, read-more links, related topics and an always-visible attribution line. Category: Compose.

items.name: term-explainer
items.title: Term Explainer
items.description: A compact explanation of one term in the user's context: definition, why it matters, the user's value placed on their document's range (text and icon status), other names, related terms and a not-advice line. Category: Compose.

items.name: service-visit
items.title: Service Visit
items.description: Schedule a technician at home from one provider's real arrival windows: triage questions, arrival-window cards with urgent fees, address with access notes and a masked gate code, optional photos, contact preference and pricing with nothing charged now, handed off as a visit request. Also shows a booked visit with technician, ETA and a two-step cancel. Category: Collect.

items.name: doctor-appointment
items.title: Doctor Appointment
items.description: Book a medical appointment from a clinic's real availability: providers, visit type, times in the clinic's time zone with an earliest-time shortcut, accepted insurance, optional reason and private note, handed off to the host's booking flow. Also shows an upcoming appointment with directions or a time-gated video link, intake forms, .ics, call and a two-step cancel. Always shows an emergency line. Category: Collect.

items.name: venue-map
items.title: Venue Map
items.description: Pick seats at a stadium, arena or concert hall: an SVG overview of ring and floor sections shaded by price or seats left, filters for tickets, max price and accessibility, a keyboard listbox of sections, then a seat grid for the chosen section with a together hint and total, or hand off with best available. Category: Collect.

items.name: password-reveal
items.title: Password Reveal
items.description: Shows a secret the user is entitled to see (Wi-Fi password, recovery codes, API key, PIN), masked until revealed, auto-hiding, with copy and best-effort clipboard clearing, or generates a strong password locally with crypto.getRandomValues. Category: Tools.

items.name: translator
items.title: Translator
items.description: A translation in the chat with an editable source, language pickers, swap, alternatives, formality, transliteration, usage notes and a glossary. The translation comes from the agent's tool. Category: Tools.

items.name: event-details
items.title: Event Details
items.description: One event the user is interested in or invited to: date and time in the event's time zone, venue with directions or an online join link, key facts, description, agenda and speakers, with RSVP, add to calendar, get tickets and share. Category: Compose.

items.name: event-pass
items.title: Event Pass
items.description: Event admission as ticket stubs: time with doors, venue, section/row/seat/gate, holder, per-ticket state, a scannable QR from the provider's payload, paging between tickets, entry rules, and wallet, transfer and download handoffs. Category: Act.

items.name: hotel-reservation
items.title: Hotel Reservation
items.description: The stay card for a booked hotel during the trip: stay state in the hotel's time zone, check-in and check-out times, room once assigned, online check-in and digital key handoffs, Wi-Fi with a masked password, amenity hours, balance due and requests, with directions, call, .ics and late check-out. Category: Act.

items.name: gift-card
items.title: Gift Card
items.description: A gift card or store credit: masked card tile, balance, expiry, recent activity and a one-tap scannable QR for the cashier; or send one with amount, design, recipient, message and delivery date, handed off to the host's payment flow. Category: Act.

items.name: flight-offers
items.title: Flight Offers
items.description: A ranked list of bookable flights from a fare search: times local to each airport, stops and layovers, fare and bags, the cheapest and fastest marked, a local sort, and one offer to pick. Category: Explore.

items.name: quick-questions
items.title: Quick Questions
items.description: A few short multiple-choice questions shown together, answered in one go and sent with one button. Category: Collect.

items.name: quantity-scaler
items.title: Quantity Scaler
items.description: Quantities that scale live with a number of people, guests or servings, with a copyable shopping list. Category: Tools.

items.name: revenue-estimator
items.title: Revenue Estimator
items.description: A participants slider, price-per-person options and the resulting total, updating live. Category: Tools.

items.name: part-diagram
items.title: Part Diagram
items.description: An interactive exploded view: line-art parts, an explode slider, system filter chips that highlight one system, and a keyboard-accessible part list. Category: Explore.

items.name: mechanism
items.title: Mechanism
items.description: A machine as an animated isometric figure, assembled from boxes, cylinders, gears and pipes: gears spin, flow runs along pipes, parts slide. Turn the view, pause and inspect each part. Drawing ported from Anatomy (MIT). Category: Explore.

items.name: photo-mosaic
items.title: Photo Mosaic
items.description: A hero collage of 1–5 photos (one large and up to four smaller) with a row of tag chips, to set the scene for a trip, a dish, a place or an event. Click a photo for a lightbox with captions. Category: Compose.

items.name: inspiration-cards
items.title: Inspiration Cards
items.description: Visual ideas as a 2- or 3-column grid of tall image cards with a bold title and one line each (outfits, interiors, recipes, gifts), optionally linked, or selectable with a single or multiple pick sent back to the agent. Category: Compose.

items.name: style-board
items.title: Style Board
items.description: Fashion looks pinned on a masonry board: images of different shapes in two or three balanced columns, each with a title and optional price, with category filter chips and a heart to save looks, sent back to the agent as one save. Category: Compose.

items.name: itinerary
items.title: Itinerary
items.description: An ordered day plan or route as a list of stops with times and thumbnails; optionally lets the user remove stops and add them back. Shares the map's stop shape. Category: Refine.

items.name: inline-app
items.title: Inline App
items.description: The escape hatch: a small self-contained HTML/CSS/JS app the agent writes when no catalog component fits, run in a sandboxed iframe with no network, themed with the host's tokens and sized to its content. Category: Layout.
